title: Verihogg SystemVerilog Formatter Configuration
description: Configuration for the Verihogg SystemVerilog formatter. Basic layout options are implemented; other style options and named profiles are reserved and have no effect yet.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this configuration schema, for editor tooling.

style.description: Named formatting profile. Not implemented yet: default, lowrisc and scr1 all use the built-in defaults.

indentation_spaces.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

line_terminator.description: Line ending used by the formatter. Implemented for lf and crlf; auto currently emits LF without detecting input line endings.

line_break_penalty.description: Penalty for introducing an additional line break during layout optimization.

over_column_limit_penalty.description: Penalty for exceeding the configured column limit.

port_declarations_alignment.description: Alignment of port direction, type, dimensions and name. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

module_net_variable_alignment.description: Alignment of net and variable declarations inside blocks. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

assignment_statement_alignment.description: Alignment of assignment statements. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

formal_parameters_alignment.description: Alignment of formal parameters in module, interface and class headers. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

named_parameter_alignment.description: Alignment of named parameters in instantiations. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

named_port_alignment.description: Alignment of named port connections. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

parameter_declaration_alignment.description: Alignment of parameter and localparam declarations in block bodies. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

case_items_alignment.description: Alignment of case item labels. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

enum_assignment_statement_alignment.description: Alignment of enum elements with assignments. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

struct_union_members_alignment.description: Alignment of struct and union members. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

class_member_variable_alignment.description: Alignment of class member variables. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

distribution_items_alignment.description: Alignment of distribution items. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

port_declarations_indentation.description: Indentation of ports in a module or interface header. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

formal_parameters_indentation.description: Indentation of formal parameters in a header. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

named_parameter_indentation.description: Indentation of named parameters in an instantiation. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

named_port_indentation.description: Indentation of named ports in an instantiation. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

alignment_group_boundary.description: Rule determining where an alignment group ends. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

port_declarations_right_align_packed_dim.description: Right-align packed dimensions in port declarations. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

port_declarations_right_align_unpacked_d.description: Right-align unpacked dimensions in port declarations. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

compact_indexing_and_selections.description: Use compact expressions inside indexes and selections. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

class_parameter_space.description: Insert a space before # in parameterized class typedefs. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

expand_coverpoints.description: Always expand coverpoints. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.

try_wrap_long_lines.description: Allow optimization-based wrapping of long lines. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting. The formatter currently always runs the line-wrap search.

wrap_end_else_clauses.description: Place end and else clauses on separate lines. Not implemented yet: accepted and stored, but has no effect on formatting.
